study.comparator: insulin glargine titrated to fasting glucose, both arms on metformin
study.notes: STUDY: 26 week randomised open label two arm parallel group trial (Kocaeli University) in insulin and incretin naive type 2 diabetes on metformin 2 g daily, HbA1c 7 to 9.5 percent, BMI 25 to 45: exenatide 5 ug twice daily for 4 weeks then 10 ug twice daily (dose_mg 0.01 per injection) vs insulin glargine 0.2 U/kg at bedtime titrated to fasting glucose 80 to 99 mg/dL; 34 randomised, 17 per arm (Table 1 sex counts 12 plus 5 and 10 plus 7), no withdrawals described; Tables 1 and 5 give pre and post treatment means plus or minus SD per arm and the per patient percent change from baseline as mean plus or minus SD per arm with between group tests (independent t test in Table 1, Mann Whitney in Table 5); rows entered as PCT with the reported percent change means and SDs (route arm_sds, no imputation), pre and post means recorded in the row notes; cardiovascular risk markers (hs-CRP, IL-6, leptin, adiponectin, TNF-alpha, Table 5) are the stated aim (prespecified TRUE), the Table 1 glycaemic and lipid rows are descriptive (prespecified FALSE); pct_weight_change is the reported mean percent change in the exenatide arm, minus 5.98 plus or minus 5.16 (glargine minus 0.93 plus or minus 3.41, between group p 0.006; 94.34 to 88.79 kg vs 90.51 to 89.66 kg); no funding statement, authors declare no conflicts (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall high

rows.notes: Table 5: hs-CRP percent change from baseline mean plus or minus SD per arm, Mann Whitney p 0.366; pre and post means 0.87 plus or minus 0.89 to 0.52 plus or minus 0.47 exenatide, 0.49 plus or minus 0.42 to 0.44 plus or minus 0.47 glargine (units not printed, immunoturbidimetric assay); within arm Wilcoxon p 0.017 and 0.469

Table 5: IL-6 percent change from baseline mean plus or minus SD per arm, Mann Whitney p 0.357; pre and post means 17.49 plus or minus 12.42 to 18.5 plus or minus 17.52 exenatide, 15.77 plus or minus 8.17 to 13.91 plus or minus 2.53 glargine (units not printed, ELISA)

Table 5: leptin percent change from baseline mean plus or minus SD per arm, Mann Whitney p 0.083; pre and post means 21.11 plus or minus 11.86 to 20.49 plus or minus 10.07 exenatide, 15.07 plus or minus 7.66 to 22.39 plus or minus 17.61 glargine (units not printed, ELISA)

Table 5: adiponectin percent change from baseline mean plus or minus SD per arm, Mann Whitney p 0.795; pre and post means 111.15 plus or minus 6.46 to 112.83 plus or minus 5.22 exenatide, 111.85 plus or minus 7.42 to 111.79 plus or minus 6.62 glargine (units not printed, ELISA)

Table 5: TNF-alpha percent change from baseline mean plus or minus SD per arm, Mann Whitney p 0.870; pre and post means 2.77 plus or minus 1.04 to 3.75 plus or minus 2.1 exenatide, 4.72 plus or minus 6.62 to 3.67 plus or minus 1.82 glargine (units not printed, ELISA)

Table 1: HbA1c percent change from baseline mean plus or minus SD per arm, independent t test p 0.370; pre and post 7.95 plus or minus 0.81 to 6.73 plus or minus 0.75 percent exenatide, 8.11 plus or minus 0.76 to 6.68 plus or minus 0.83 glargine

Table 1: fasting plasma glucose percent change from baseline mean plus or minus SD per arm, independent t test p 0.029; pre and post 159.53 plus or minus 39.51 to 140.82 plus or minus 27.92 mg/dL exenatide, 173.65 plus or minus 42.06 to 120.76 plus or minus 19.03 glargine (glargine titrated to fasting glucose)

Table 1: triglyceride percent change from baseline mean plus or minus SD per arm, independent t test p 0.344; pre and post 173.29 plus or minus 89.38 to 146.53 plus or minus 98.96 mg/dL exenatide, 226 plus or minus 87.32 to 158.35 plus or minus 62.2 glargine

Table 1: LDL cholesterol percent change from baseline mean plus or minus SD per arm, independent t test p 0.174; pre and post 115.82 plus or minus 25.75 to 102.88 plus or minus 31.43 mg/dL exenatide, 110.18 plus or minus 34.96 to 103.53 plus or minus 32.08 glargine

json.design: randomised open label two arm parallel group trial, exenatide twice daily vs insulin glargine on metformin, type 2 diabetes, 34 randomised (17 per arm), 26 weeks
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); nine inventory markers from Tables 1 and 5 entered as the reported per patient percent change from baseline with SD per arm (arm_sds route, no imputation)
other_markers: weight, BMI, total body fat mass (kg), waist circumference
flow mediated dilation and nitroglycerin mediated dilation (Table 4)

rob.justification: randomised without a described sequence or concealment (D1 some concerns); open label with a titrated insulin comparator (D2 some concerns); no participant flow or withdrawals reported, 17 per arm in the tables (D3 some concerns); laboratory assays for all entered markers (D4 low); no registration or protocol cited, marker set named in the aims (D5 some concerns); small open trial with several domains at some concerns, overall high

doubts: the percent change rows are means of per patient percent changes (not percent changes of the arm means); the pre and post means with SD are in the row notes so the imputed MD route can be substituted if preferred
units of the Table 5 markers are not printed (adiponectin about 111, leptin about 21, IL-6 about 17), which does not affect the percent rows
the Table 5 between group tests are Mann Whitney on skewed percent changes; the arm_sds route treats the printed means and SDs as normal summaries
